name: West Indies' Hot 'n' Sweet Chilli flavor
ingredients_raw: Potato (80%), Edible Vegetable* Oil, **Seasoning (Sugar, Maltodextrin, lodised Salt, Spices and Condiments, Flavour (Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances), Flavour Enhancers (627, 631), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palm, Sunflower, Peanut), Hydrolysed Vegetable Protein, Cocoa Solids, Lactose). **As flavouring agent. *To know the specific type of oil used and its saturated fat value, match the symbol or # with the last character of batch number where ◊ denotes Palmolein and # denotes Rice Bran Oil.
